# Maiia

Maiia is a Software Development company. Maiia Agenda is a company that provides online agenda services for healthcare professionals. They offer a range of services including consultations, 24/7 access, and teleconsulting. Maiia employs 46 people. Headquartered in Boulogne-Billancourt, Île-de-France, France. Its workforce is distributed across France and Vietnam.

## About

Née en mars 2020, Maiia est une solution de Cegedim Santé, un des quatre piliers du groupe CEGEDIM, leader français de l’informatique médicale fondé il y a 50 ans.
Après deux années de recherche et d’analyse, nous avons co-construit avec le corps médical la solution d’Agenda, prise de rendez-vous en ligne et téléconsultation la plus complète et évolutive du marché.
Notre ambition : devenir l’assistance digitale santé de référence pour les professionnels de santé et leurs patients.
Avec 1 100 collaborateurs experts, Cegedim Santé accompagne quotidiennement les praticiens dans l'évolution de leur pratique médicale.
Aujourd'hui, Maiia dispose de 20 000 professionnels de santé qui utilisent notre solution au quotidien.

# Maia

Maia is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Maia is an AI-powered autonomous coding and RCM company that provides solutions for orthopaedics practices. They offer a range of products including e/m autocoders, surgical autocoders, accurate cpt coding for complex operative notes, denial appeals, documentation, compliant notes and templates, prior auth, collections and contracting, analytics, and more. Maia employs 10 people (+350.0% YoY, +7 people), founded in 2024. Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, United States, with an office in Dover. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Germany.

## About

Maia is an AI-powered revenue cycle platform purpose-built for orthopaedic practices. Maia works alongside your existing workflows to proactively code cases, improve authorization accuracy, and reduce downstream denials—before claims are submitted.

Orthopaedic revenue cycle complexity continues to increase as procedures grow more specialized, payer rules change frequently, and staffing shortages strain administrative teams. Maia helps practices stay ahead by continuously monitoring clinical, authorization, and coding data to surface issues early and guide corrective action.

How Maia Improves Performance for Our Clients:

Maia compares scheduled procedures, clinical documentation, and payer rules to ensure pre-authorizations match what will ultimately be billed. When mismatches are detected, Maia flags them early—helping teams correct issues or trigger re-authorization before services occur.

Maia analyzes operative notes and documentation to surface potential coding gaps, missing specificity, or compliance risks. This supports coders by reducing rework, minimizing post-bill corrections, and improving first-pass claim accuracy.

Instead of reacting to denials after the fact, Maia focuses on prevention. By identifying risk earlier in the workflow, practices can reduce avoidable denials tied to authorization errors, documentation gaps, and coding inconsistencies.

Maia automates repetitive review and monitoring tasks, allowing revenue cycle and administrative staff to focus on higher-value work. This reduces manual audits, shortens turnaround times, and helps teams operate more efficiently without adding headcount.

Maia is designed specifically for orthopaedic practices, supporting high-volume surgical workflows, specialty-specific coding nuances, and evolving payer requirements common in musculoskeletal care.

Improved authorization-to-bill alignment
Fewer preventable denials
Faster reimbursement cycles
Reduced administrative burden
Better visibility into RCM risk

properties.name: Maia
properties.description:
Maia is an AI-powered revenue cycle platform purpose-built for orthopaedic practices. Maia works alongside your existing workflows to proactively code cases, improve authorization accuracy, and reduce downstream denials—before claims are submitted.

Orthopaedic revenue cycle complexity continues to increase as procedures grow more specialized, payer rules change frequently, and staffing shortages strain administrative teams. Maia helps practices stay ahead by continuously monitoring clinical, authorization, and coding data to surface issues early and guide corrective action.

How Maia Improves Performance for Our Clients:

Maia compares scheduled procedures, clinical documentation, and payer rules to ensure pre-authorizations match what will ultimately be billed. When mismatches are detected, Maia flags them early—helping teams correct issues or trigger re-authorization before services occur.

Maia analyzes operative notes and documentation to surface potential coding gaps, missing specificity, or compliance risks. This supports coders by reducing rework, minimizing post-bill corrections, and improving first-pass claim accuracy.

Instead of reacting to denials after the fact, Maia focuses on prevention. By identifying risk earlier in the workflow, practices can reduce avoidable denials tied to authorization errors, documentation gaps, and coding inconsistencies.

Maia automates repetitive review and monitoring tasks, allowing revenue cycle and administrative staff to focus on higher-value work. This reduces manual audits, shortens turnaround times, and helps teams operate more efficiently without adding headcount.

Maia is designed specifically for orthopaedic practices, supporting high-volume surgical workflows, specialty-specific coding nuances, and evolving payer requirements common in musculoskeletal care.

Improved authorization-to-bill alignment
Fewer preventable denials
Faster reimbursement cycles
Reduced administrative burden
Better visibility into RCM risk
